item.title: Alice Springs woman sexually assaulted while putting child into vehicle
item.description: A woman securing her child into her vehicle at a Gregory Terrace carpark in Alice Springs just after noon on Monday was allegedly indecently assaulted by a male youth, with police now calling for the public's help to identify the male.

item.title: NT Criminal Court list – with charges – Feb 12
item.description: The 270 names facing criminal courts in the Northern Territory for Thursday, February 12, 2026. This list includes all the charges.

item.title: Half of Health’s Acacia IT system shelved pending new funding despite risk of ‘catastrophic failure’ of systems
item.description: Half of the controversial $320 million NT Health Acacia patient record IT system is being shelved pending new funding approvals, bureaucrats have told a parliamentary committee, despite their own previous warnings that not fully implementing it risks a "catastrophic IT systems failure" that could disrupt health services.

item.title: ‘Detrimental change’: NT Police’s Darwin property and juvenile crime unit to be moved
item.description: Darwin's property and juvenile crime police unit, Strike Force Trident, is being moved from the Casuarina Police Station to be absorbed by the Crime and Intelligence Command at the Peter McCauley Centre, the police union has said, a move the man who established the unit said could see members siphoned off to other parts of the agency due to political pressures, leading to a potential increase in property crime.

item.title: ICAC releases investigation findings into NT WorkSafe conflicts of interest, failure to manage staff
item.description: UPDATED: The Independent Commissioner Against Corruption has disclosed the findings of its investigation into allegations NT WorkSafe's electrical inspectors unit misused statutory powers, failed to manage conflicts of interest and failed to disclose secondary employment with commercial electrical companies the workplace regulator may have investigated.

item.title: 80-year-old woman robbed and assaulted in home invasion by kids as young as eight: Police
item.description: Four youths aged between eight and 12 allegedly robbed an 80-year-old woman on Wednesday night after breaking into her Karama home, assaulting her and demanding her car keys, NT Police said.

item.title: Reece Kershaw given new undisclosed job at St John Ambulance
item.description: Former Australian Federal Police commissioner Reece Kershaw has been hired by St John Ambulance NT in a new undisclosed role, following the appointment of a new chief executive, while both the NT branch and St John Ambulance Australia declined to respond to an allegation that a preferred CEO candidate was put forward by the federal body and rejected by the NT organisation.

item.title: AFP investigating dysfunction in NT Police top brass
item.description: EXCLUSIVE: The NT Police top brass is currently under investigation by a senior member of the Australian Federal Police, the NT Independent can reveal, who was recently sworn in to conduct a probe into "allegations against a number of people up on the top floor".

item.title: Nightcliff byelection set for March 7
item.description: The byelection to select the next Member for Nightcliff will be held on March 7, with the Greens and Labor announcing their candidates out of the gate, while the CLP is yet to put a candidate forward.

item.title: Machete fight on Alice Springs Council lawns ends in arrests, one in hospital
item.description: One person was taken to hospital with cuts to his back and three others were arrested after a machete fight through the Alice Springs CBD on Friday afternoon, NT Police said, while other offenders remain at large.
